summary: Iteration 7 micro-regression verified. The two HIGH-priority bugs from iteration_6 are FIXED: (1) Register → /onboarding redirect now lands cleanly on step 1 of the 6-step wizard (no longer bounces to /dashboard); (2) GlobalSearch Cmd+K dialog no longer emits the 'DialogContent requires a DialogTitle' a11y warning (sr-only DialogTitle + DialogDescription confirmed in /app/frontend/src/components/GlobalSearch.jsx lines 83-86). End-to-end flows verified: fresh register → onboarding step 1; full wizard step 1 → 6 (with industry skip + file upload skip) completes and 'Open my workforce' navigates to /chat/:agentId; 'Skip for now' button hits POST /api/onboarding/skip and navs to /dashboard; PublicOnly mount-snapshot correctly redirects already-logged-in users from /login and /register → /dashboard. Backend regression: ALL 91 backend tests pass (66 V1-V5 + 25 V6, +1 skipped which is a DEV_MODE-only path — unchanged from iteration_6). Additional UI checks: Theme toggle dark↔light persists in localStorage qiq-theme and toggles .dark class on <html>; Departments CRUD (create with multi-agent checkbox → list renders new card with toast); Chief of Staff /api/chief/route returns 2232-char reply with 1 delegation in ~45s; Global Search returns 9 results in 245ms across agents + conversations; Error pages /nonexistent (404), /403, /500, /maintenance all render. Reload on /onboarding keeps user on /onboarding (state persists via backend status).

critical_code_review_comments: PublicOnly's useRef mount-snapshot is a clean, minimal fix — it preserves initial-mount redirect for already-authed users while suppressing post-setUser re-render redirects that previously raced with imperative nav(). Tested both directions (logged-out → register lands on /onboarding; logged-in visiting /login or /register → /dashboard) and both behaviors are correct.
Onboarding.jsx useEffect no longer auto-redirects on completed=true (line 53-55 only adjusts step). 'Skip for now' is the only path out of the wizard. This is the intended UX per problem statement.
GlobalSearch DialogTitle is sr-only — confirmed zero radix DialogTitle warnings in console after Cmd+K open/type/escape.

Frontend NotificationBell uses data-testid='notif-bell' on the inner button (NOT 'notification-bell'). Spec in iteration_6 said 'notification-bell' — update docs OR rename testid for consistency. Bell badge visually shows '1' on admin dashboard, so unread count IS rendering.
Chief of Staff page uses data-testid='chief-route-btn' and 'chief-task' (NOT 'chief-submit'/'chief-input'). Just a doc-vs-impl mismatch.

rca_of_the_issue: Original RCA: PublicOnly re-rendered after Register called setUser() (AuthContext update) and emitted a <Navigate to='/dashboard'> that won the race against Register's imperative nav('/onboarding'). FIX (in /app/frontend/src/App.js): PublicOnly now snapshots `!!user` into useRef on first non-loading render and reads from the ref thereafter — so it never re-renders a <Navigate> after the initial mount decision. Verified: (a) fresh registrant lands and stays on /onboarding through reload; (b) already-logged-in user visiting /login or /register still gets redirected to /dashboard (initial-mount path preserved). GlobalSearch a11y fix: added <DialogTitle className='sr-only'>Global search</DialogTitle> and <DialogDescription className='sr-only'>...</DialogDescription> inside <DialogContent>. Zero radix warnings now.
